name: CodeBlockWindow
description: Framed code block with a title bar, language label, optional line numbers, and copy button; renders pre-highlighted Shiki output with theme-aware syntax colors.

title.description: Optional title or filename shown in the header

caption.description: Optional caption rendered below the code

language.description: Language label shown in the header

showLineNumbers.description: Force line numbers on/off (defaults to presence in Shiki output)

context.description: Article prose layout — 80% width, 35vh max height, wrap + vertical scroll

criteria.note: 2026-07-06 — beta→stable: AT snapshots bootstrapped across base/light/dark/forced-colors (all beta-matrix stories green, deterministic); shiki dual-theme (--shiki-light/--shiki-dark) syntax colors + forced-colors CanvasText mapping verified. 2026-07-10 — Figma component built (Molecules, node 1164-257): traffic-light chrome on DT tokens, Shiki body bound to the new code/shiki/* per-theme variables (values extracted from codeBlockFixtures.ts), header/caption on code/toolbar-text.

deprecation.reason: Superseded by CodeBlock (2026-10-25, react 0.1.38). CodeBlockWindow drew macOS window chrome (traffic-light dots, centred title, text Copy button) around a Shiki tree and had one layout switch (context="article"). CodeBlock keeps what worked (Flight-lazy unwrapping before introspecting server children, copy with an execCommand fallback, the Lenis wheel opt-out for scrollable bodies, translated region label) and adds a filename header or floating copy column, line numbers, highlighted/added/removed rows with signs, a terminal theme, wrap and maxHeight, and runtime highlighting for code strings. Migrated consumers: ArticlePageTemplate MDX figures, /dev/code-window.
